channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Doc Rivers | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Doc Rivers from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Glen Davis on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Glen Davis on Doc Rivers:

“He was a good motivator and he was a good offensive scheme coach. He knew what to do offensively. And he was a good motivator meaning as far as just the moment. There were moments where we needed him to say something to push us through and he would come and say something dope. But as far as player-wise,I think he was a horrible coach for players. When you look at all the players that he's kind of killed their careers as far as just, it's like he he got a lot of kills. He killed a lot of players that could have played a little bit more, but you know.”

Glen Davis on Doc Rivers, Sep 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Al Jefferson on Paul Pierce, Doc Rivers, Chris Wallace
item.description:
Al Jefferson:

“That was Doc Rivers’ first year. Let me tell you what happened. This was in May, right? I’m flying to Boston for my first NBA workout, and I have no idea what to expect. Now, it’s 90 degrees in Mississippi, so I’m wearing a Paul Pierce jersey with the sleeves cut off and some shorts. I show up in Boston, and it’s cold as hell. Chris Wallace, the GM, had just bought a new car and lost it in the airport parking lot. We walked around for 45 minutes trying to find his car. Finally, we had to call for one of those airport carts to drive us around until we found it.”

Al Jefferson on Paul Pierce, Doc Rivers, Chris Wallace, Dec 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: MarJon Beauchamp on Doc Rivers
item.description:
For a third straight summer, MarJon Beauchamp, the Bucks’ 2022 first-round selection (No. 24), will be suiting up again as the team tips off in summer league action on Saturday at 3:30 p.m. CT against the Chicago Bulls.

“Iasked (Bucks coach Doc Rivers) and he said he wanted me to play two games and it’s up to me after that,”

MarJon Beauchamp on Doc Rivers, Jul 13, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Malik Beasley on Doc Rivers
item.description:
“And that shows how great Doc Rivers is and it shows how great our players are in understanding that and doing it.”

Malik Beasley on Doc Rivers, Feb 4, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Daryl Morey, on the decision to move on from Doc Rivers:

“We felt like that was the best move for helping us get to our goals going forward... I recommended it to ownership, and they accepted it.”

Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers, May 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Ray Allen on Doc Rivers, George Karl, Bob Hill, Erik Spoelstra, Bob Weiss
item.description:
Of course, more than 20 seasons of playing college and professionally combined meant a lot of coaches have impacted Allen’s basketball prowess.

“When I’m saying things it's Coach (Jim) Calhoun, it’s Doc Rivers, it’s Erik Spoelstra, George Karl, Bob Weiss and Bob Hill. It’s Jeff Lynch. my high school coach. It’s every coach that ever touched hands on me,”

Ray Allen on Doc Rivers, George Karl, Bob Hill, Erik Spoelstra, Bob Weiss, Jan 14, 2023. Source: CTInsider.com.

item.title: Tobias Harris on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Harris also isn’t worried about having to move back to the small forward position.

“I mean, Doc (Rivers) says the 3 and the 4 are pretty identical,”

Tobias Harris on Doc Rivers, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers, James Harden
item.description:
Daryl Morey on James Harden:

“Look, between the money he gave up and his commitment to the franchise from Day 1 to do what (head coach Doc Rivers) wants … I’m someone who looks at data quite a bit. All the players on the team’s shooting percentages went way up off passes from him. Our team overall was elevated after he came. Joel and James were the No. 1 pick-and-roll combo — really (in) years;it wasn’t just last season. It just shows the overall impact and how he’s lifting the whole team to help us win a title.”

Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers, James Harden, Sep 13, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Morey on why he assures that Rivers will be back:

“I just think he's a great coach and I love working with him.”

Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers, May 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Gina Mizell:DeAndre Jordan on reuniting with Doc Rivers:

“He’s the best coach I’ve ever had,he’s more than a coach to me … when a new player comes to a team, it’s always everybody trying to get them to feel acclimated, but with Doc, he’s gonna curse me out like I’ve been here all season”

DeAndre Jordan on Doc Rivers, Mar 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: James Harden on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Lauren Rosen:James Harden on why he's always wanted to play for Doc Rivers:

“One of the best coaches to ever coach the game of basketball. Why wouldn't I want to be led by that?”

James Harden on Doc Rivers, Feb 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Adam Sandler on Doc Rivers
item.description:
And on a recent episode of The Dan Patrick Show,Sandler himself confirmed the members of the Sixers that were present for a recent shoot.

“Yesterday, I did a scene with Doc Rivers, and a bunch of the Sixers were in there,”

Adam Sandler on Doc Rivers, Aug 27, 2021. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Julius Erving:

“It's been a long drought in Philadelphia, our fans are eagerly awaiting for the team to get over the top. There's a lot of controversy with the Ben Simmons situation, but it seems like the team is staying pat with their big three of Joel [Embiid], Ben [Simmons] and Tobias [Harris].I think if they add pieces, get another year in with Doc Rivers, because you know last year was his first year on the job with the Sixers. Sometimes you need time with people to really know how to bring out the best in them.”

Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Aug 27, 2021. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Dwight Howard, Danny Green, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Julius Erving:

“First of all, [the Sixers] have an advantage coaching-wise based on experience with [head coach Doc Rivers], in terms of championship experience that [Green has], that Dwight [Howard] has. And the ambition of Ben [Simmons] and Joel [Embiid], these guys are hungry now, they’ve been a part of what they call ‘The Process’ for several years, and it’s time for The Process to bear some fruit. I’m betting my money on Philly… Ws mean confidence. It’s not cool to be overconfident, but it’s very cool to be confident. So you need to maintain that confidence and get out there and perform, that’s the way I see it.”

Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Dwight Howard, Danny Green, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Apr 9, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“Doc Rivers obviously has won one. I haven't gotten there yet. Joel and Ben haven't gotten there yet. But, you know, I think you do this, you go into every season, hoping to win the title,not a lot of teams have a chance, but we absolutely have a chance and we're going to continue to work hard so we give ourselves the best chance possible. And I think we have a very good chance.”

Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers, Jan 30, 2021. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Paul George on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Doc Rivers
item.description:
Paul George on his struggles in Doc Rivers' system:

“Doc was trying to play me as a Ray Allen or a JJ Redick, all pin-downs. I can do it, but that ain't my game. I need some flow, I need some mixes of some pick-and-roll, and post ups... That last season was hard.”

Paul George on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Doc Rivers, Dec 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons
item.description:
A month later, Daryl Morey was being introduced as the Sixers' president of basketball operations.

“To have two star-plus players at 24 [Simmons] and 26 years old [Embiid] - that is why I couldn’t get Doc Rivers to come interview in Houston,”

Daryl Morey on Doc Rivers, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Nov 7, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on the Doc Rivers news:

“I'm excited for Doc and for the Sixers. He's a great coach and great for the league. I'm happy he's quickly back in the NBA.”

Steve Kerr on Doc Rivers, Oct 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Doc Rivers, Danny Ainge
item.description:
Brian Robb:Kevin Garnett on his upcoming jersey retirement:

“I’m honored and thankful to have my number retired with the Celtics. I will always have immense respect and appreciation for ownership, Danny Ainge, Doc Rivers, my past teammates and Celtic Nation!”

Kevin Garnett on Doc Rivers, Danny Ainge, Feb 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Natalie Nakase on Doc Rivers
item.description:
“It’s a stepping stone Doc Rivers gave me the opportunity to do. I’m blessed he gave me the opportunity.”

Natalie Nakase on Doc Rivers, Jul 13, 2019. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Doc Rivers
item.description:
“Everybody is screaming New York but do not be surprised if K.D. signs and plays for Doc. I don’t even have to recruit him. He likes the organization. He likes Doc Rivers.”

Kendrick Perkins on Doc Rivers, May 23, 2019. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: David Fizdale on Doc Rivers
item.description:
“I have no thought process about what I’m pitching. I've got Doc Rivers sitting in the other locker room now with a damn good basketball team that I have to be focused on.”

David Fizdale on Doc Rivers, Mar 24, 2019. Source: Bergen Record.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“Your dad, [Doc Rivers], was an NBA coach, you've been able to work out with Paul Pierce and [Kevin Garnett] and Ray Allen and all that. We felt like you had the upperhand. He had the NBA socks when we were playing. We were thinking about all of this stuff. You had access to all this stuff and we didn't. We were kind of envious of it. His game was like super far advanced from everybody else; his handle, his floater, everything. In a way, we were like 'man, this dude.' We were kind of jealous of him for a little bit.”

Bradley Beal on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Kevin Garnett, Sep 28, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Doc Rivers, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Tracy McGrady on Doc Rivers telling Tim Duncan during Duncan's free agency courtship that significant others weren't allowed on the Magic team plane:

“I just found this out over the All-Star break. I had no idea. No idea. Doc Rivers, man? You wait till I see him.”

Tracy McGrady on Doc Rivers, Tim Duncan, Mar 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @JoshuaBRobbins.

item.title: LeBron James on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Rajon Rondo, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
LeBron James:

“So, it's going to be very challenging. Those guys are going to challenge me. They're going to challenge our ballclub. This is a high-powered teamand I've played against some other (stiff competition). I've played against Ray (Allen), KG (Kevin Garnett), Paul (Pierce), (Rajon) Rondo and Doc (Rivers). So, it's going to be very challenging not only on me mentally, but on our ballclub and on our franchise.”

LeBron James on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Rajon Rondo, Kevin Garnett, May 28, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Draymond Green on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Draymond Green:

“I've got a tremendous respect for Doc (Rivers) as a man. That's more important than anything.”

Draymond Green on Doc Rivers, Nov 4, 2015. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Ben Bolch:DeAndre Jordan on what he expected from Doc Rivers' playlist:

“I thought there was going to be some Earth, Wind and Fire.”

DeAndre Jordan on Doc Rivers, Sep 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Adam Silver on Doc Rivers, Dick Parsons
item.description:
Silver told The Associated Press this week.

“Doc Rivers is the head of basketball operations of the Clippers. We've installed Dick Parsons as the interim CEO. He's on the same page as Doc. They're working together. Dick Parsons has the absolute authority from the league office to operate the Clippers in the best interest of the organization.”

Adam Silver on Doc Rivers, Dick Parsons, Jun 13, 2014. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Adam Silver on Doc Rivers
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Silver:

“I have complete confidence in Doc Rivers and the management of that club, and they deserve support.”

Adam Silver on Doc Rivers, Apr 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Doc Rivers, Paul George
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Terry Stotts on Paul George:

“I heard Doc Rivers say he got Most Improved Player last year & he could get it again; he's made another jump.”

Terry Stotts on Doc Rivers, Paul George, Dec 2, 2013. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.
